_noteW: Despair: 'Magic Damage Per Tick: 5 (+ 0.5/0.625/0.75/0.875/1% (+0.25% per 100 AP) of target's MAXIMUM health)'. Two independent BIN calcs (both hashed/unlabeled by Riot but fully evaluable -- same precedent as Briar P's '{15da76ad}'): (1) flat term '{c8e45bc3}' = mMultiplier(0.5) x NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=10 constant) = 5, matching the wiki's flat '5' exactly; (2) %maxHP term '{8a96509c}' = GameCalculationModified(mModifiedGameCalculation='TotalHealthDamage', mMultiplier=0.005). 'TotalHealthDamage' itself = NamedDataValue(HealthDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat -> AP default, APRatio=0.005) evaluates to PERCENTAGE-POINT-scaled PER-SECOND values (HealthDamage DataValues rank1-5 = 1.0/1.25/1.5/1.75/2.0, exactly DOUBLE the wiki's per-TICK 0.5/0.625/0.75/0.875/1.0% because ticks fire every 0.5s); the outer x0.005 multiplier folds BOTH the per-second-to-per-tick halving (x0.5) AND the percentage-point-to-fraction conversion (x0.01) into one constant (0.5*0.01=0.005), so '{8a96509c}' evaluates directly to the real per-tick fraction (e.g. rank1, 0 AP: 1.0*0.005=0.005=0.5% per tick, matching the wiki exactly; +100 AP: (1.0+100*0.005)*0.005=0.0075=0.75%, matching the wiki's '+0.25% per 100 AP' exactly). Modeled hpBasis Max per the wiki's explicit 'of target's MAXIMUM health'. Curated as ONE tick (count 1), matching Brand P/Skarner P's established 'one tick, not the full DoT duration' precedent for toggled/DoT auras.
